title: Alen Ladavac - Taking CI and automated testing seriously - WebCamp Zagreb 2018
summary: Alen Ladavac of Croteam talks about continuous integration and automated testing pipelines in games, with case studies from The Talos Principle and Serious Sam.
why: HN points to it as a rare, practical look at how a game studio tests its games and engine.

quote.text: Here's also a good overview how Croteam (creators of Serious Sam and The Talos Principle) approach automated testing
